description: For each trader type, count the distinct transactions that have at least one advanced behaviour analysis and a matching trader. Report that count and its share of the total count over all trader types.

c.request: For each trader type, how many analysed trade records are there in the advanced behaviour data (only where the trade and its trader can be found), and what share of the overall total does each type make up? Keep the share unrounded. For each trader type, count the distinct transactions that have at least one advanced behaviour analysis and a matching trader. Report that count and its share of the total count over all trader types.
c.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS cnt FROM transactionrecord tr JOIN advancedbehavior ab ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind) SELECT tradekind, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM counts ORDER BY cnt DESC;

a.request: Considering only advanced behaviour analyses whose linked transaction record and trader both exist, for each trader type (`tradekind`) give the trader type, the number of distinct transactions analysed (a transaction analysed twice counts once), and that number divided by the total of these numbers over all trader types, without rounding.
a.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS txn_count FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind) SELECT tradekind, txn_count, txn_count::numeric / SUM(txn_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts;

b.request: For each trader type, count distinct transactionrecord rows that have at least one advancedbehavior row (via translink) and a matching trader (via trdref → tradereg), grouped by trader.tradekind, reporting each count and its percentage of the total count across all trader types without rounding
b.sql: SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS record_count, COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS percentage FROM transactionrecord tr JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM advancedbehavior ab WHERE ab.translink = tr.transreg) GROUP BY t.tradekind;

d.request: For each trader type, how many distinct transactions have at least one advanced behaviour analysis and a matching trader, and what share of the total does each type make up? Keep the share unrounded.
d.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT DISTINCT t.tradekind, tr.transreg FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref) SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM matched GROUP BY tradekind ORDER BY tradekind;
